headline: At Long Last, Alabama Legislature Establishes Independent Tax Tribunal
snippet: Senate passed 26-0, House 94-1. Independent forum replacing Revenue Dept's internal division.

headline: BCA President Commends Governor on TBOR II Signing
snippet: Bentley signed Act 2014-146 creating Alabama Tax Tribunal, praised as long-sought reform.

headline: Long Road to Tax Fairness
snippet: Made Alabama 32nd state with independent tax appeals panel after decade of advocacy.
